- Revenue of $164,501 million  
- Income from operations of $69,380 million  

[DOC]

> “CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME (in millions)  
> Fiscal year 2024: Revenue $164,501; Income from operations $69,380.”

Operating margin = Income from operations ÷ Revenue  

= 69,380 ÷ 164,501 ≈ 0.4217, or about 42.2%.
